probe_loaded_gantry.title: Push the crane
probe_loaded_gantry.caption: Recorded crane motion with a choreographed RB-Y1 grasp.

probe_laptop_hinge.title: Lower the laptop lid
probe_laptop_hinge.caption: A simulated force lowers and taps the laptop lid, then closes and releases it. The hinge motion is recorded; no robot hand was simulated.

probe_curtain_release.title: Lift and release the curtain
probe_curtain_release.caption: A simulated force lifts the curtain hem. The opening holds at about 30 cm, then settles to 6 cm after release. The top stays attached to the rod; no robot hand was simulated.

activity_sequence_parts.title: Arrange the parts
activity_sequence_parts.caption: Take one part at a time from the rack with four bins. Seat the cover from the lower red bin, the bracket from the upper blue bin and the housing from the lower blue bin in the first, middle and last slots of the other rack’s lower slotted shelf. Check that all three are seated. Roll that rack toward the conveyor and stop before the laptop cart, with the parts still in order, the blue bin aboard and nearby equipment undisturbed. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

activity_battery_service.title: Transfer the batteries
activity_battery_service.caption: Take the empty blue bin from the lower shelf of the rack with just one bin and set it on the clear end of the conveyor. On the laptop cart, lift the battery nearest the laptop out of its charger and set it on the clear front of the cart. Stand the other battery in the bin, carry the loaded bin back to its original shelf, then reseat the first battery in its charger. Leave it seated and the other battery upright in the bin, with nearby equipment undisturbed. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

activity_arena_reset.title: Reset the arena
activity_arena_reset.caption: Move the orange entry cone beside the white foam block to just outside the nearest blue floor marking, at the trial corner. Bring the wooden crate from beside the yellow barrier to the floor beside the low wooden platform. Set the large box from the floor beside that platform on top of the crate. Once the box, crate and cone are stable, move the box to the middle of the platform and return the crate to its original spot. Leave the cone marking the corner and the surrounding equipment in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

activity_padded_drop.title: Drop the box onto the pad
activity_padded_drop.caption: Recorded simulation. Pick up the large box on the floor beside the low wooden platform. Carry it over the white pad between the low platform and the taller one, then let go. Once the pad has caught the box and it has settled upright, pick it up again and set it on the roller conveyor. Leave it upright and still, with nearby equipment undisturbed.

workflow_trial_preparation.title: Prepare the test lab
workflow_trial_preparation.caption: At the rack with four bins, take the housing from the lower blue bin, the bracket from the upper blue bin and the cover from the lower red bin, one at a time. Seat them in that order in the first, middle and last slots of the other rack’s lower slotted shelf. Roll the loaded rack toward the conveyor and stop before the laptop cart. Check that all three parts and the blue bin stayed aboard. Carry the unstacked conveyor box to the middle of the low wooden platform. Move the entry cone beside the white foam block to just outside the nearest blue floor marking, then close the laptop on the cart. Roll the blue wheeled crane away from the conveyor and let it stop with the suspended humanoid robot clear of the floor and equipment. Leave the parts, box and cone stable and nearby equipment in place. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.
